name: NH Collection Madrid Abascal
description: Located in the heart of Madrid’s commercial district, NH Collection Madrid Abascal is ideal for both the business and the leisure traveler. Gregorio Marañón and Alonso Cano metro stations are within a short walk, providing guests easy access to the city’s top attractions such as the Art Triangle, as well as the airport and the IFEMA complex. Salesas and Salamanca neighborhoods offer guests boutique shopping, while Madrid’s gastronomical variety is also nearby at Chamberí’s trendy restaurants and tapas bars. For those in Madrid on business, Paseo de la Castellana is a short distance away. NH Collection Madrid Abascal is housed in a historical building that was previously home to some of Madrid’s wealthiest families. Recently renovated and redesigned, it features 183 rooms, each equipped with Nespresso machines, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service for your comfort. Many rooms have a living area and some enjoy access to a terrace and spectacular city views. Guests can enjoy the delicious breakfast served daily with a variety of healthy homemade options. The DOMO Abascal restaurant offers local fare and delicacies and guests may also relax with a drink at the lobby bar or on the cozy indoor terrace. There is a gym on-site.
